title: The normalized scalar route computes the common ordinary tensor model
statement: Let a:Λ→Λ′, f:X→Y, D,V,L,B be as in [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Choose tX with TensorNormalized on X and lam:D_Y L_S≅L_R D_X with PullNormalized; no Y tensor presentation is used. For every homotopy complex P let b,c,T_P,C_P be the explicit comparisons of [def-sfb-internal-scalar-tensor-pull-models]. Then b at D_Y(Qh P), followed by V_X(lam.hom), tX.derived at L_R(Qh P), and T_P, equals C_P. No K-flatness or flatness of a is assumed.

theorem scalar_pull_route_model (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (tX : TensorNormalization a X)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X)
    (hX : TensorNormalized a X tX) (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Modules Λ Y) (.up ℤ)) :
    (scalarTensorRestrictPullIso a f).hom.app ((D a Y).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
        (V a X).map (lam.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
        tX.derived.hom.app ((L Λ f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
        scalarTensorPullModelTarget a f P = scalarTensorPullModelMap a f P
